name: Flex
overview: Following the lives of eight strivers navigating their quarter-life crisis in Bondi and its iconic coastal surrounds. It’s a masterclass in surviving Sydney’s most affluent areas, laying bare the ‘fake it till you make it’ reality of a generation under pressure. As the party girl lifestyle trades places with pre-dawn fitness culture,  the curtains are pulled back on the gruelling hustle required to stay hot, stay relevant, and stay in the game. In this world, your physique is your currency and your community is your competition.
